The local build.sh script now invokes OpenEXR's
[share/util/oss-fuzz_build.sh](https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openexr/blob/main/src/test/oss-fuzz/oss-fuzz_build.sh),
the OpenEXR project has direct, local control over the build steps.

The oss-fuzz_build.sh script now vendors in the master branch of OpenJPH
prior to building the fuzzer, ensuring that we pick up the recent
changes to the dependent library.

Signed-off-by: Cary Phillips <cary@ilm.com>
